mutants.description: Mutant 1: Ignores knock-in barrier breach at maturity, paying full principal even when spot settles below barrier.
Mutant 2: Disables coupon accumulation, dropping missed coupons rather than remembering them.
Mutant 3: Flips dealer delta and gamma signs to match client position rather than dealer short position.
Mutant 4: Fails to terminate paths upon autocall event, continuing to pay subsequent coupons and redemptions.
Mutant 5: Computes gamma as first derivative rather than second centered difference (divides by h instead of h^2).
